name: strict-tab-suspender
description: Private-first Chrome extension that discards eligible inactive tabs.

scripts.release:verify: npm run verify && npm run smoke:chrome
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run package && npm run package:verify && npm run smoke:chrome
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run tests/integration
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run build && npm run package && npm run package:verify && npm run package:reproducible
